IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: ALTA VISTA SCHOOL PROVIDES ELEMENTARY AND MIDDLE SCHOOL EDUCATION TO ENROLLED STUDENTS.
IRS990.MissionDesc: AN INDEPENDENT, COMMUNITY ELEMENTARY AND MIDDLE SCHOOL IN SAN FRANCISCO OFFERING A PROGRESSIVE LEARNING ENVIRONMENT WITH AN EMPHASIS ON SCIENCE, MATH AND TECHNOLOGY.
IRS990.Desc: THE SCHOOL PROVIDES STUDENTS WITH A RIGOROUS, YET FUN AND ENGAGING EDUCATION THROUGH PROGRESSIVE, EXPERIENCE-BASED LEARNING GROUNDED IN THE SCIENTIFIC METHOD AND DELIVERED THROUGH SMALL CLASS SIZES. THE SCHOOL EDUCATES 306 STUDENTS IN GRADES JUNIOR KINDERGARTEN THROUGH FIFTH GRADE AT THE LOWER SCHOOL AND SIXTH THROUGH EIGHTH GRADE AT THE MIDDLE SCHOOL.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ALTA VISTA SCHOOL PUBLICIZES ITS POLICY IN ALL EDUCATION AND PROGRAM MATERIALS, AND ON THE SCHOOL'S WEBSITE. ALTA VISTA SCHOOL ALSO PUBLISHED ITS NOTICE OF ITS NONDISCRIMINATORY POLICY IN A NEWSPAPER OF GENERAL CIRCULATION, THE SAN FRANCISCO EXAMINER, DURING THE REPORTING PERIOD.

ALTA VISTA SCHOOL DOES NOT DISCRIMINATE ON THE BASIS OF RACE, COLOR, NATIONAL ORIGIN, ETHNIC ORIGIN, RELIGION, GENDER, LIFESTYLE, SEXUAL ORIENTATION, DISABILITY AND AGE IN THE ADMINISTRATION OF ITS EDUCATIONAL POLICIES, ADMISSION POLICIES, FINANCIAL AID AND LOAN PROGRAMS, ATHLETIC AND OTHER SCHOOL-ADMINISTERED PROGRAMS, HIRING PRACTICES, AND PRIVELEGES, PROGRAMS AND ACTIVITIES GENERALLY ACCORDED OR MADE AVAILABLE TO STUDENTS, PARENTS, AND EMPLOYEES OF THE SCHOOL.
ALTA VISTA SCHOOL PROVIDES A LIMITED NUMBER OF SCHOLARSHIPS FOR TUITION REDUCTION. FINANCIAL AID APPLICATIONS ARE REVIEWED BY THE FINANCIAL AID COMMITTEE, AND AWARDED ON BASIS OF NEED.

BusinessName.BusinessNameLine1Txt: MISSION STREET COMMERCIAL CONDOMINIUM LLC (ABDUR & ANA CHOWDHURY)

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION RETAINED A PROFESSIONAL CPA FIRM TO PREPARE THE FORM 990. THE FORM 990 WAS THEN REVIEWED BY THE FINANCE COMMITTEE CHAIR, AUDIT & RISK CHAIR, AND HEAD OF SCHOOL.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ALL BOARD MEMBERS ARE REQUIRED TO REFRAIN FROM TRANSACTIONS THAT MAY POSE A CONFLICT WITH ALTA VISTA SCHOOL, AND MUST ANNUALLY SIGN AN AFFIDAVIT TO THAT EFFECT.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: AFTER A REVIEW OF COMPARATIVE SALARIES IN REGIONAL EXEMPT ELEMENTARY SCHOOLS, THE BOARD SETS COMPENSATION FOR THE HEADMASTER.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, EXEMPTION APPLICATION AND FORM 990 ARE AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC UPON WRITTEN REQUEST.
THERE HAS BEEN NO CHANGE IN THE MANNER IN WHICH THE ANNUAL AUDIT IS OVERSEEN BY THE AUDIT COMMITTEE.
